issue_context.title: enhance cancel test
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
There are many tests related to admin cancel ddl, it's better to put these tests together and use a general framework to test them.

review_comments: The concurrent data deletion is removed in the new test?
Yes, I don't think we need to modify data for the cancellation.
why need check reorg canceled here? it will return `dbterror.ErrCancelledDDLJob` if the job is cancled
It may return ok even if reorgCancel is set.
